stem:
The figure shows a shaded rectangle inside a parallelogram.

[Image: A shaded rectangle inside a parallelogram]

What is the area of the shaded rectangle?

Answer: ____

descriptors: Other incorrect (including crossed out/erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

scoring_notes: Note: There is no distinction made between responses with or without units.
figure_description: A parallelogram with horizontal top and bottom sides and slanted left and right sides. Inside the parallelogram is a shaded rectangle sharing parts of the top and bottom edges of the parallelogram. A dimension line at the bottom shows that the distance from the bottom-left vertex of the parallelogram to the bottom-right corner of the shaded rectangle is 8 cm. A dimension line along the top shows that the segment of the parallelogram's top edge extending to the right of the shaded rectangle has a length of 3 cm. A vertical dimension line on the right indicates that the height of the parallelogram (and of the rectangle) is 4 cm.
